slot_scores.name: van_ev_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether vans and electric vehicles are mutually exclusive or can be used together, and did not mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_pollution_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of this plan — for example, minimize total pollution, minimize total number of trips, minimize cost, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included minimizing total pollution as an option, fully covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Both vans and electric vehicles can be used simultaneously without any mutual-exclusivity restriction.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists all four vehicle types as decision variables with no restriction preventing both vans and EVs from being used together.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 van/EV mutual-exclusion slot remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked clear, relevant questions and resolved the objective and several boundary issues, but it missed the P1 van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint and silently assumed both vehicle types could be used together.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
